claim_boundary: Public synthetic planted and natural (published scalar) targets on the retained rank-guided n=53 base. Relations are found by a streamed meet-in-the-middle over the Frobenius-quotiented regular-root index (no pair table, no edge selectors), then confirmed as a SAT model of the orbit-factorized S5 formula with orbit reps, Frobenius shifts, and both S3 intermediates pinned; the solver verifies (0 conflicts) and does not search. Per-relation extraction is ~100x slower than the explicit table's post-precompute lookup. Not a vs_rho win, not an asymptotic claim, pending independent replay.
